faqItems.question: How long does it take to get a visa?
faqItems.answer: Processing time varies by visa type. Tourist visas usually take 5-7 business days; work visas may take 15-20 days.

faqItems.question: What documents are required?
faqItems.answer: Basic documents include a passport valid for 6 months, ID photos, and the application form. Additional documents may be required depending on visa type.

faqItems.question: Can I apply online?
faqItems.answer: No, Chinese visa applications must be submitted in person at the consulate. We can assist you with every step.

faqItems.question: Is the visa refundable?
faqItems.answer: Visa fees are not refundable if refused. We carefully review your file before submission.

blog.ctaTitle: Ready to start your import project?
blog.ctaDesc: Contact us to discuss your project and get a personalized quote.
blog.introText1: Import-export with China represents a major opportunity for African entrepreneurs. With millions of products available at competitive prices, China remains the world's leading supplier of diverse goods.
blog.introText2: In this article, we will explore the different steps to succeed in your import-export operations, the pitfalls to avoid, and best practices to optimize your costs.
blog.advantage1Desc: Production costs in China allow for attractive margins.
blog.advantage2Desc: Millions of products available in all categories.
blog.advantage3Desc: Chinese factories can handle orders of all sizes.
blog.advantage4Desc: China is at the forefront in many technological sectors.
blog.quote: The key to success in import-export is having a trusted partner on the ground who understands local realities.
blog.stepIdentifyDesc: Precisely define what you want to import.
blog.stepSupplierDesc: Use our Personal Shopping services to identify the best suppliers.
blog.stepShippingDesc: Choose the transport mode suited to your needs.
blog.tipText: Start with small quantities to test the market and quality before placing larger orders.
blog.conclusionText1: Import-export with China can be very profitable if you follow best practices. Don't hesitate to seek professional support to secure your operations.
blog.conclusionText2: At NADOM, we support you at every step of your project, from product research to delivery at your door.
